channel.title: Vanilla
channel.description: News about Vanilla, the app for saving web pages and reading them later.

item.title: Discover lists fewer posts
item.description: Discover now lists each site's three newest posts from the last three days, instead of everything from the past week, so a few busy sites can't fill it with hundreds of posts. Change both in Sites, with Posts per Site and Show Posts From. Dismissing every post leaves the list empty until there's something new, and posts are cleared after 14 days rather than 30.
